title: Plasma balls turning into solid objects in UFO legacy program testimonies

tellings.quote: And when you see testimonies of, you know, people in the quote unquote UFO legacy program and these plasma balls seem to kind of cohhere and become inert and turn into these solid objects and then come out of the sky once they're summoned

plain: Some people said to have been part of the "UFO legacy program", meaning a supposed secret government effort to recover and study unknown craft, describe balls of plasma that pull together, go inert and turn into solid objects, then come down out of the sky once they are summoned. Michels sums up these testimonies himself, without naming who gave them, while talking with Jeffrey Mishlove, a PhD who studies psychic phenomena and the afterlife.
